name: Civic Job Posting
description: Provides a Job content type and emits schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD, with optional Google Indexing API notifications.
project_description: Civic Job Posting installs a ready-made "Job" node type (with a Paragraph-based location sub-type) whose fields map to the schema.org JobPosting vocabulary. On each published job page it injects a schema.org/JobPosting JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> block into the page head so the posting is eligible for Google's job-search rich result. It can optionally notify the Google Indexing API (via google/apiclient and a service-account credential) whenever a job node is created, updated or deleted. Requires the paragraphs and field_group modules. Developed by Civic UK.
